responsiveModes.wrap: Content/actions wrap inside the component; no page-level horizontal overflow.
responsiveModes.grid-to-stack: Multi-column content reduces columns or stacks while preserving reading order.
responsiveModes.stack-controls: Controls stack on narrow screens while labels/status/consequences stay adjacent.
responsiveModes.contained-scroll: Wide semantic content scrolls only inside a keyboard-reachable local container.
responsiveModes.state-panel: State message, status, and recovery/next action remain visible together at narrow widths.

themeModes.semantic-surface: Semantic background/surface/border/text/muted tokens in light and dark.
themeModes.semantic-accent: Semantic accent tokens with explicit high-contrast foregrounds; meaning is not color-only.
themeModes.semantic-status: Semantic state/status tokens plus explicit text/iconography in light and dark.

a11yRules.semantic-group: Use native structural semantics that match the component's standalone/grouped meaning.
a11yRules.named-controls: Interactive controls need unambiguous accessible names in repeated contexts.
a11yRules.keyboard: All interactive behavior must be reachable and operable from the keyboard.
a11yRules.programmatic-state: Selection/current/processing state must be exposed programmatically.
a11yRules.explicit-status: State or status must be stated in text, not inferred from styling.
a11yRules.no-color-only: Meaning cannot depend on color alone.
a11yRules.labels: Inputs need explicit labels and associated helper/error text when present.
a11yRules.error-recovery: Errors must preserve context and expose a clear recovery path.
a11yRules.table-semantics: Comparisons use real table semantics with associated headers.
a11yRules.scroll-focus: Contained horizontal scroll regions must be keyboard reachable.
a11yRules.status-live: Dynamic status changes must be exposed to assistive technology when they occur.
a11yRules.reduced-motion: Processing/motion behavior must respect reduced-motion preferences.
a11yRules.data-authoritative: Render normalized/provider/policy data; do not fabricate or infer authoritative facts.
a11yRules.consequence-visible: Price, scope, renewal, eligibility, or mutation consequences remain inspectable before action.
a11yRules.heading-order: Preserve a logical heading and reading order.
a11yRules.list-semantics: Chronological or repeated records use appropriate list semantics.
a11yRules.masked-secrets: License keys or secret-like values remain masked until an explicit user action reveals/copies them.
a11yRules.current-location: Current navigation/progress location is programmatically determinable.
a11yRules.text-equivalent: Visual indicators have an equivalent textual label/value.
